utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Rosa’s still confirming the exact time and place, but it’s lined up around the school schedule. I’ll send the details once everything’s set.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I can help with sorting donations and a few basic repairs. Just send me the final details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Sam — that’ll help a lot. I’ll send the final details as soon as Rosa confirms the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — it’s this Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center, and folks can drop off tools and see what still needs fixing. I’ll keep an ear out too, and I’ll pass the details along to Eli as well.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks — I’m heading out now and will ask around while I’m on errands. If anything else gets confirmed, let me know and I’ll be back around 3.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Ira — I’ll let you know right away if I hear anything. Hope the errands go smoothly!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still waiting on the final repair drive times, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I hear from Jules. Rosa’s got it organized, so we should know soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Nell — Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center still works for me, and I’ll plan around school pickups.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I’ll keep an eye out for Jules’s update and send the final details along as soon as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s fine, Dane — if you join late, I’ll point you to the bit that still needs doing. We’re keeping Sunday’s repair drive small and straightforward at the community center, with Bo as the first stop.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — just point me to the part that still needs doing when I get there, and I’ll take a small piece of it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I will, Dane — I’ll show you the part that’s still open when you arrive. See you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll bring a clear list of the drop-off items, and we’re set for Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Saturday at 10 at the community center? Just to confirm, is that actually locked in, or is Rosa still finalizing the time and place?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, it’s locked in: Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center. I’ll keep the drop-off list ready so we can stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll be there Saturday at 10 at the community center, and I’m bringing the tool bag and a few extra tools. Sounds like Mina’s screws and flashlight will come in handy too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday afternoon at the community hall, not 10 at the community center. And yeah, I’ll flag anything off once Jules sends the details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, got it — Saturday afternoon at the community hall. I’ll still bring the tool bag and extra tools, and I’ll help sort the donations when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yep, it’s still on for Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center. I’ll bring duct tape and a screwdriver, and we could still use a few more hands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll keep spreading the word and pass along anything new. Pia’s invited, and Vik’s on it too—hopefully we get a few more hands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. That should help a lot — we’re still short on duct tape and a couple more screwdrivers, too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Still waiting on Rosa’s exact time and place, but it’s planned for this afternoon. I’ll stop by around 3 and pass along any updates.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the first stop as Bo’s place, and Rosa also said it’s set for Sunday at the community center. If you hear back on the exact time, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll let you know as soon as Rosa confirms the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’ll get there a little early to sort out the parking. It should help if Rey and Sam are already set with their tools and repair jobs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’d be a big help, Pia—thank you. I’ll make sure Rey and Sam have their tools and repair jobs lined up before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks. As long as everyone’s set for Saturday afternoon at the community hall, we should avoid any last-minute mix-ups.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and help sort out who needs what. We’re set for Saturday at 10 at the community center, and Pia’s coming early to handle parking.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — I thought it was Saturday afternoon at the community hall, not 10 at the center. We still need a couple screwdrivers and a few extra hands, right?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, Saturday at 10 at the community center is the plan, and I’ll keep telling folks to come pitch in. We could still use a couple screwdrivers and a few extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can help if you still need volunteers. What time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mina — I’ve got you on the volunteer list. We’re set for Saturday afternoon at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time Saturday afternoon should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I still need to confirm the exact start time for Saturday afternoon, and then I’ll let Mina know. Do we still need any volunteers for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s this Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center. Folks are already pitching in tools and parts, so we’re in pretty good shape.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll pass that along to Mina. And since you’re in good shape, I’ll just keep checking whether anyone else still needs to volunteer.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s Saturday at 10 at the community center, and Pia’s coming early to sort parking. Rey’s bringing duct tape and a screwdriver, and Dane may show up a bit late to handle a small part.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll stop by around 3 and pass along any timing updates. We could still use a few more hands for sorting and basic repairs.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, that works — Gus is coming around 3 with a tool bag and extra tools, and he’ll help sort donations at the hall. I’ll keep repeating the plan in case Rosa finalizes any timing or place updates.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—the repair drive is this Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center, and folks can drop off tools and see what still needs fixing. I’ll pass those details along to Eli and Ira too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—yeah, I might've missed a bit. Can you ask Vik to help sort out who needs what, and remind folks we still need a couple screwdrivers and extra hands?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—I’ll ask Vik to help sort out who needs what, and I’ll remind everyone we still need a couple screwdrivers and extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — send me the repair drive details when they’re set, and I’ll flag anything that looks off. My place is the first stop, so that part sounds right.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep — it’s this Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center, and they mostly need help sorting donations, plus a few people with tools for basic repairs. I’m planning to help Leo with both.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds right to me — Saturday at 10 at the community center works, and my place being first still lines up. I’ll keep an eye out for anything else that seems off.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: It’s this Saturday afternoon at the community hall, and Bo’s place is the first stop. I’m still not sure whether they need more volunteers yet.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, that’s what I’ve got too — Rosa’s still confirming the exact time and place, and Dane’s joining a bit late. I’ll let you know if I hear they need more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — please do, and I’ll wait for Rosa’s final details before I pass anything on.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still waiting on Rosa to confirm the final time and place, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell. It’s still on for Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center, and we could still use a few more hands, duct tape, and a couple of screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll share Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center and mention they still need a few more hands, duct tape, and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll be there late and can only take on a small part, but I can still help once I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That works — I’ll note you for a small part when you arrive. We’re starting at the community center parking lot tomorrow morning, after the first stop at Bo’s place.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll swing by late and take on a small part when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s still set for Saturday afternoon at the community hall, and we could use a few more hands and a couple more screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Actually, it’s Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center. I’ll bring the clear drop-off list, and Sam and Dane can fill in the rest.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, thanks for the correction — Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center works. I’ll note the clear drop-off list and that Sam and Dane are covering the rest.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll bring the tool bag and a few extra tools when I swing by around 3 this afternoon. Saturday at 10 at the community center should be a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — I’ve got your 3 o’clock arrival noted with the tool bag and extras. Just a quick correction: the repair drive is this Saturday afternoon at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks for the correction, Mara — I’ll note Saturday afternoon at the community hall. I’ll still swing by around 3 with the tool bag and extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s on Sunday at the community center, and Bo’s our first stop. I’m keeping it small and simple, and I’ll let Nell and Dane know as needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, that sounds right. I’ll send Bo the details to review, and then we can keep the rest nice and simple.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. That’ll help keep it all neat and simple.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you still need volunteers for the repair drive? I can help, and I may be able to bring spare screws and a flashlight too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would be great, Mina — thank you. It’s this Saturday afternoon at the community hall, and I’m planning to get there a little early to sort out parking.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll come by Saturday afternoon and help out. I’ll also try to bring the spare screws and flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s really coming together nicely — folks are pitching in tools and parts. Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure about Saturday at 10 at the community center? I thought Rosa was still locking down the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s what I’ve got in my notes — Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center. I’ll keep an ear out this afternoon in case Rosa sends any last-minute update.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m heading out to run a few errands and ask around, so if anything gets confirmed, let me know. I should be home around 3, and Leo can stop by then if the timing works out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Ira — I’ll pass along any updates. Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center still works for me, and I’ll keep it around the school pickups.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks — that timing should work for me too. I’ll be back around 3, so let me know if Oren or Vik confirms anything while I’m out.
